rule_title: Educational Case Studies & Partner Portal Disclosures
title: Exempt Verified Educational Case Studies on Enterprise Partner Portals
rationale: Historical review analysis indicates that 38% of all flags on TERM-007 were overridden by Brand Reviewers with reason code JUSTIFIED_EDUCATIONAL_CONTEXT. Refining the scope to exempt closed enterprise partner portals eliminates false-positive friction without compromising public consumer compliance.

diff.previous_text: All educational case studies and technical thought leadership articles must display full state statutory disclosures prominently.
diff.proposed_text: All educational case studies and technical thought leadership articles must display full state statutory disclosures prominently, except when published exclusively within verified enterprise partner portals.
